name: Myka Riley
source:
LIKES: Cats 
DISLIKES: Ghosts

Recent university graduate with a business degree, Myka spends his time sketching and working at the Merryment Cafe as a barista.

He also has a keen interest in the study of mythology and history.

More than anything he seeks closure on his childhood after he lost his memory in a mysterious accident.
